title: Frequently Asked Questions
text:
Frequently Asked Questions 
 Frequently 
 Asked Questions 
 Q: Why does the 
 PDC Voucher Date sometimes differ from the Debit Voucher Date? 
 Answer: 
 This discrepancy occurs when the 
 Debit voucher is generated on a particular date, resulting in the 
 PDC date and the date of voucher generation being different. 
 Q: What 
 could cause an issue with selecting banks in Receipt- Payment? 
 Answer: 
 The issue may arise due to the type of document-wise tagging. Banks 
 associated with a specific prefix are displayed during transactions. 
 It's recommended to utilize Business Unit-wise ledger tagging instead 
 of TOD-wise tagging when using a single prefix for all Business units. 
 Q: 
 Why am I unable to delete 
 an On Account adjustment entry? 
 Answer: If you're unable to delete 
 the On Account adjustment entry, it might be an Inter Unit On Account 
 adjustment entry. Locate the entry from On Account Adjustment IU and 
 proceed with the deletion process. 
 Q: Why 
 is a bank not showing in the cash bank detail ? 
 Answer: The 
 bank may not be appearing in the Cash Bank query because no transactions 
 have been conducted for that particular bank within the specified 
 company. 
 Q: Why am I not seeing certain options 
 like Enterprise/Company ? 
 Answer: If 
 you're not seeing Enterprise / Company options, it's likely because 
 your user account doesn't have permissions for all business units. 
 Please ensure that the user has been granted permissions for all business 
 units from the Admin module, and then check again. 
 Q: Why am I unable to generate the voucher 
 from PRQ generation against the requisition if a subledger is selected 
 in ‘Other Charges’ ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs when a subledger is selected in the ‘Other Charges’ section. 
 This section is intended for booking additional charges, such as bank 
 charges, along with the payment. If you don't want to include any 
 other charges, leave the field blank and then generate the voucher. 
 Q: Why am I encountering a JV entry error 
 ‘Parent Bu Id Should Be Present In Detail’ ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs during an Inter Unit Journal entry when the Business 
 unit is not selected in the Grid line along with the account head 
 whose balance needs to be transferred. Make sure to select the appropriate 
 Business unit in the Grid line for the account head. 
 Q: Why is the TDS assessable value incorrect 
 i.e. more than the bill amount ? 
 Answer: The 
 TDS assessable value might be such, because the TDS yearly limit has 
 been exceeded. To verify this, generate the Ledger report with the 
 provisional option enabled to get detailed information about the entries 
 and ensure compliance with TDS regulations. 
 Q: Why 
 is TDS being deducted for 194Q although yearly limit not crossed ? 
 Answer: TDS 
 is being deducted because the TDS yearly limit entry has not been 
 entered for the selected supplier and the company whose business unit 
 is selected for the entry. Please enter the TDS yearly limit entry 
 for the relevant supplier and company, and then verify the deduction. 
 Q: Why is there a TDS issue despite the yearly limit 
 being exceeded ? 
 Answer: Kindly 
 conduct a thorough review. For example, if you are sure that the yearly 
 limit of 50,00,000 for TDS nature 194Q (TDS on Goods) has been exceeded. 
 Please review all entries created after 01/04/2023 with TDS Payable 
 as nil. Note that entries made with TDS payable as nil nature after 
 01/04/2023 will not be considered under limit checking. 
 Q: Why 
 am I encountering a "Save Error (Doc Length Error)" when trying 
 to save a journal voucher (JV) in Finance ? 
 Answer: The 
 error message appears when the document number exceeds 16 characters. 
 The validation requires that any GSTR1-type entries should have the 
 document no. less than or equals to 16 characters. 
 Q: Why does "A/c Payee" get printed 
 on the cheque when I print a self cheque ? 
 Answer: To 
 prevent "A/c Payee" from being printed on the cheque, please 
 ensure to uncheck the "Print A/c Payee" checkbox before 
 printing from the Print Cheque Information section, then proceed with 
 the printing process. 
 Q: Why is the daily payment data not updating 
 in reports and widgets? What kind of payments is displayed in the widgets 
 for Daily Payment Creditors ? 
 Answer: The 
 widgets for Daily Payment Creditors only display the amount of payment 
 made to a Supplier type of ledgers. If the payment is made to any 
 General ledger or any Customer type of ledger, then the effect for 
 the same will not appear in the widgets. 
 Q: Why 
 is the cash flow showing negative ? 
 Answer: If 
 the payment exceeds the receipts, the balance will appear as negative. 
 If there is mismatch between Cash flow and Cash bank book balance 
 then execute the Cash Flow balance generation process, and then generate 
 the report again. 
 Q : 
 Why am I 
 not able to delete the JV ? 
 Answer: The 
 message is appearing because the particular journal is already adjusted. 
 Kindly remove the adjustment first, then proceed to delete. Refer 
 to the Bill wise payment details register to get the details of the 
 adjustment entry. 
 Q : 
 Why is TDS 
 not showing while doing the receipt payment entry if the Nature tagged 
 is “TDS ON BROKERAGE COMMISSION WO-ST” ? 
 Answer: The 
 issue is occurring because the TDS nature 'TDS ON BROKERAGE COMMISSION' 
 is not tagged. Kindly tag this TDS nature instead of 'TDS ON BROKERAGE 
 COMMISSION WO-ST', and then check again. 
 Q : 
 What 
 could be the reason behind the error message “BUID not found” encountered 
 while importing Receipt/Payment entries ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs because the business unit entered in the sheet does not 
 exist or there is a spelling mismatch. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 is the Basic Amount showing against CGST payable account head ? 
 Answer: The 
 Basic Amount is appearing in CGST payable because the posting is done 
 correctly. In the Ledger report, when multiple ledgers are debited 
 and multiple ledgers are credited in one voucher, only the top one 
 opposite side ledger is displayed in the report. 
 Q : 
 What could be the reason 
 behind the error message “Parentid not found” encountered while importing 
 Journal entries ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs because the parent account head is not entered for some 
 of the Sub ledgers selected in the import sheet. Kindly update the 
 parent account head for those entries and then import again. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 is no data appearing in the TDS deduction register for a specific period 
 and company ? 
 Answer: No 
 TDS deduction has been made in the specified period for the selected 
 company. Therefore, no data is appearing in the report. Kindly refer 
 to the Trial Balance to confirm that no postings exist for TDS deductions. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 is there an issue with the loan module ? 
 Answer: Manual 
 entry effects will not be processed in the loan module. An alternate 
 solution is to remove the manual entry and pass the entry directly 
 from the loan module. 
 Q : 
 Why can't we choose a date from the 
 previous year when entering opening unclear cheques? 
 Answer: Opening 
 unclear cheques should be entered on the first day of the financial 
 year. There's no need to input them before the start of the financial 
 year. 
 Q : 
 Why is the Export To Excel function 
 not working in Bulk Payment? 
 Answer: The 
 Export to Excel feature becomes active after generating the Receipt 
 Payment. It provides details of the voucher generated against the 
 bill. For Bulk Payment, exporting to Excel is possible only after 
 generating the voucher. 
 Q : 
 What causes the error “Parent Bu 
 Id Should Be Present In Detail” to occur? 
 Answer: The 
 “Parent Bu Id Should Be Present In Detail " error may occur when 
 performing an Inter Unit Journal. Ensure that the Business Unit in 
 header is selected in the Grid line along with the account head whose 
 balance needs to be transferred. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 am I unable to make a payroll journal entry, and how can I resolve the 
 error "Invalid InterUnit Document” ? 
 Answer: The 
 error "Invalid InterUnit Document" occurs when attempting 
 to submit the payroll journal entry. To resolve this, ensure that 
 the voucher is generated only through the payroll module using Payroll 
 Receipt payment or Payroll Journal document type. If manually passing 
 the entry from the Journal form, use the Normal document type. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 is the bank account not appearing in the Receipt/Payment Mode options ? 
 Answer: The 
 bank account may not be showing due to the Type of Document (Tod) 
 wise 
 tagging for Cash Bank type of ledgers. Note that Business Unit wise 
 ledger tagging will not function if Tod wise tagging is applied. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 is there a balance showing in the INTER UNIT STOCK TRANSFER A/C ledger 
 at the company level ? 
 Answer: The 
 balance in the Inter Unit Stock Transfer A/c should be zero automatically, 
 upon making Goods Receipt Note (GRN) against all the Inter Unit Stock 
 Transfer Order (ILTO) entries, and no manual entries should be passed. 
 If the balance persists despite meeting these criteria, please contact 
 the Customer support for further assistance. 
 Q : 
 Why is the bank list not shown in cheque 
 printing ? 
 Answer: The 
 bank list will only appear in cheque printing for banks with pending 
 vouchers for cheque printing. If there are no vouchers pending for 
 cheque printing for a particular bank, it will not appear in the bank 
 list during cheque printing. 
 Q : 
 Why is the payment requisition 
 against the RA bill payable showing more than the bill amount in ERP ? 
 Answer: The 
 ERP system calculates the balance amount based on the actual amount 
 due to be adjusted and the amount already adjusted in the particular 
 payment entry. If an existing entry is opened, the balance amount 
 shown may exceed the bill amount due to this calculation logic. 
 Q : 
 Why is the Parent ledger 
 not showing in the Trial Balance report whereas sub-account heads are 
 showing ? 
 Answer: The 
 parent ledger's net balance is zero, causing it not to appear in the 
 Trial Balance report. Hence, any ledger with opening, periodic, and 
 closing balances with zero will not be included in the Trial Balance 
 report or query. 
 Q : 
 Why are the Trial Balance 
 opening and period totals not appearing when the "Without Nil Balance" 
 option is selected ? 
 Answer: The 
 "Without Nil Balance" option filters out ledgers with closing 
 debit and credit balances of zero. Therefore, if this option is checked, 
 ledgers with zero closing balances will not be included in the report, 
 resulting in blank opening and periodic totals. 
 Q : 
 What is causing errors during 
 inter-company fund transfer entries ? 
 Answer: Errors 
 during inter-company fund transfer entries occur when the business 
 unit selected in the grid line is incorrect. 
 Q : 
 What should be done to resolve 
 errors encountered during the modification of receipt/payment vouchers ? 
 Answer: 
 1. Edit the voucher. 
 2. Remove the grid line. 
 3. Add a new row again with the updated details. 
 4. 
 Proceed to save the entry. 
 Q : 
 How to resolve errors related 
 to "Invalid ledger detail document" and "ledger detail 
 COA balance mismatch" encountered during deposit withdrawal ? 
 Answer: 
 1 . 
 Edit the voucher. 
 2. Remove the grid line. 
 3. Add a new row again with updated details. 
 4. 
 Proceed to save the entry. 
 Q : 
 Why is there a mismatch 
 between the bill amount shown in the entry and the payment billwise details 
 report for a bill ? 
 Answer: The 
 bill amount shown in the report represents the net payable amount, 
 excluding any deduction amount. 
 Q : 
 Why is the TDS deduction 
 not showing in the Query Cash Bank ? 
 Answer: The 
 Trial Balance at the last level (Ledger Detail Summary) displays the 
 net balance value, which accounts for deductions such as TDS. For 
 example, if the supplier is debited for Rs. 10,000 and TDS is deducted 
 at 1%, the net value shown in the Trial Balance will be Rs. 9,900. 
 Q: 
 Why is the TDS Nature '194 Q TDS on Goods[194Q]' not showing for selection 
 in NSP bill booking? 
 Answer: The TDS Nature '194Q TDS 
 on Goods' is specific to Goods type of entries and is not available 
 for Service types of bills in NSP, Sub contractor bill. To utilize 
 the '194Q' TDS nature, please use the Direct Purchase bill instead 
 of NSP, Sub contractor bill. 
 Q: 
 What does the JV import 
 error “Debit amount should be more that 0” signify ? 
 Answer: The 
 error indicates that there are debit lines in the voucher where the 
 amount is specified as 0. Please review the Ledger detail sheet and 
 correct any such entries before attempting to import again. 
 Q: 
 Why is the system not 
 allowing adding BU in E-payment Setup ? 
 Answer: The 
 error indicates that there are debit lines in the voucher where the 
 amount is specified as 0. Please review the Ledger detail sheet and 
 correct any such entries before attempting to import again. 
 Q: 
 What might be causing 
 the error in the Ledger Columnar Detail/Summary Report ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs when a ledger is not selected in the Account Head field 
 having transactions. To resolve this, ensure that a valid ledger with 
 transactions is selected, and then generate the report. Note that 
 the report will be generated account head wise. 
 Q: 
 What could be causing 
 the error “Bill balance cb mismatch” during JV import ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs because adjustment details have not been entered. To 
 resolve this, update the adjustment details and then proceed with 
 the import. 
 Q: 
 How 
 to restrict the TDS / GST / AR / AP / GL / INV transactions to the previous 
 month? 
 Answer: 
 In order to do the above, follow these 
 steps. Navigation 
 Path: Financials> Audit> Period Lock 
 Select the parameter for which the restriction 
 needs to be made. Click on the Checkbox. The status will change to 
 “Lock”.

 credit which is not applicable? 
 Answer: In 
 order to achieve that, follow these steps. Navigation 
 Path: Financials> Transaction>Journal 
 Fill in the parameters as required and choose 
 “Rule 42” under document type. After the transaction, it will be reflected 
 in the “GST Detail” report.

 it possible to utilise the ITC (Input Tax Credit) amount according to 
 the Business Unit? 
 Answer: No, 
 the basic rule to utilise an ITC (Input Tax Credit) amount is based 
 on the GSTIN number not the Business Unit.

 be made for the advance amount paid in Project A when the bill is generated 
 for Project B? 
 Answer: To make adjustments for the advance amount paid 
 in Project A when the bill is generated for Project B, under the Finance 
 module, go to Adjustment> On Account Adjustment – IU. 
 Q: Can 
 a bank account be restricted on a company-wide basis? 
 Answer: Yes! 
 This can be done from this path: Financials> Setup> Filter> 
 Business Unit Wise Ledger Tagging . There is an option where you 
 can choose the specific account head for a particular business unit.

 the account group of a General Ledger? 
 Answer : To 
 change the account group, navigate to Account Group Master and select 
 the ‘Transfer Head’ option. 
 Q: Is it possible 
 to import Payment entries from Excel? 
 Answer : Yes, 
 in the Receipt/Payment entry section, there is an option to import 
 entries from Excel. 
 Q: How 
 to perform a BRS import? 
 Answer : This 
 can be done from the following path: Finance> Setup> Banking> 
 BRS Import Setup. 
 Q: Can the 'Other 
 than Reverse Charge amount' be adjusted before the 'Reverse Charge' amount 
 in the ITC Utilisation entry as per GST rules? 
 Answer : No, 
 as per the GST rule, ‘Reverse Charge’ amount should be adjusted first.

 Q: Why does the 
 PDC Voucher Date sometimes differ from the Debit Voucher Date? 
 Answer: 
 This discrepancy occurs when the 
 Debit voucher is generated on a particular date, resulting in the 
 PDC date and the date of voucher generation being different. 
 Q: What 
 could cause an issue with selecting banks in Receipt- Payment? 
 Answer: 
 The issue may arise due to the type of document-wise tagging. Banks 
 associated with a specific prefix are displayed during transactions. 
 It's recommended to utilize Business Unit-wise ledger tagging instead 
 of TOD-wise tagging when using a single prefix for all Business units. 
 Q: 
 Why am I unable to delete 
 an On Account adjustment entry? 
 Answer: If you're unable to delete 
 the On Account adjustment entry, it might be an Inter Unit On Account 
 adjustment entry. Locate the entry from On Account Adjustment IU and 
 proceed with the deletion process. 
 Q: Why 
 is a bank not showing in the cash bank detail ? 
 Answer: The 
 bank may not be appearing in the Cash Bank query because no transactions 
 have been conducted for that particular bank within the specified 
 company. 
 Q: Why am I not seeing certain options 
 like Enterprise/Company ? 
 Answer: If 
 you're not seeing Enterprise / Company options, it's likely because 
 your user account doesn't have permissions for all business units. 
 Please ensure that the user has been granted permissions for all business 
 units from the Admin module, and then check again. 
 Q: Why am I unable to generate the voucher 
 from PRQ generation against the requisition if a subledger is selected 
 in ‘Other Charges’ ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs when a subledger is selected in the ‘Other Charges’ section. 
 This section is intended for booking additional charges, such as bank 
 charges, along with the payment. If you don't want to include any 
 other charges, leave the field blank and then generate the voucher.

 error occurs during an Inter Unit Journal entry when the Business 
 unit is not selected in the Grid line along with the account head 
 whose balance needs to be transferred. Make sure to select the appropriate 
 Business unit in the Grid line for the account head.

 i.e. more than the bill amount ? 
 Answer: The 
 TDS assessable value might be such, because the TDS yearly limit has 
 been exceeded. To verify this, generate the Ledger report with the 
 provisional option enabled to get detailed information about the entries 
 and ensure compliance with TDS regulations.

 is TDS being deducted for 194Q although yearly limit not crossed ?

 is being deducted because the TDS yearly limit entry has not been 
 entered for the selected supplier and the company whose business unit 
 is selected for the entry. Please enter the TDS yearly limit entry 
 for the relevant supplier and company, and then verify the deduction. 
 Q: Why is there a TDS issue despite the yearly limit 
 being exceeded ? 
 Answer: Kindly 
 conduct a thorough review. For example, if you are sure that the yearly 
 limit of 50,00,000 for TDS nature 194Q (TDS on Goods) has been exceeded. 
 Please review all entries created after 01/04/2023 with TDS Payable 
 as nil. Note that entries made with TDS payable as nil nature after 
 01/04/2023 will not be considered under limit checking. 
 Q: Why 
 am I encountering a "Save Error (Doc Length Error)" when trying 
 to save a journal voucher (JV) in Finance ? 
 Answer: The 
 error message appears when the document number exceeds 16 characters. 
 The validation requires that any GSTR1-type entries should have the 
 document no. less than or equals to 16 characters. 
 Q: Why does "A/c Payee" get printed 
 on the cheque when I print a self cheque ? 
 Answer: To 
 prevent "A/c Payee" from being printed on the cheque, please 
 ensure to uncheck the "Print A/c Payee" checkbox before 
 printing from the Print Cheque Information section, then proceed with 
 the printing process. 
 Q: Why is the daily payment data not updating 
 in reports and widgets? What kind of payments is displayed in the widgets 
 for Daily Payment Creditors ? 
 Answer: The 
 widgets for Daily Payment Creditors only display the amount of payment 
 made to a Supplier type of ledgers. If the payment is made to any 
 General ledger or any Customer type of ledger, then the effect for 
 the same will not appear in the widgets. 
 Q: Why 
 is the cash flow showing negative ? 
 Answer: If 
 the payment exceeds the receipts, the balance will appear as negative. 
 If there is mismatch between Cash flow and Cash bank book balance 
 then execute the Cash Flow balance generation process, and then generate 
 the report again. 
 Q : 
 Why am I 
 not able to delete the JV ? 
 Answer: The 
 message is appearing because the particular journal is already adjusted. 
 Kindly remove the adjustment first, then proceed to delete. Refer 
 to the Bill wise payment details register to get the details of the 
 adjustment entry. 
 Q : 
 Why is TDS 
 not showing while doing the receipt payment entry if the Nature tagged 
 is “TDS ON BROKERAGE COMMISSION WO-ST” ? 
 Answer: The 
 issue is occurring because the TDS nature 'TDS ON BROKERAGE COMMISSION' 
 is not tagged. Kindly tag this TDS nature instead of 'TDS ON BROKERAGE 
 COMMISSION WO-ST', and then check again. 
 Q : 
 What 
 could be the reason behind the error message “BUID not found” encountered 
 while importing Receipt/Payment entries ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs because the business unit entered in the sheet does not 
 exist or there is a spelling mismatch. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 is the Basic Amount showing against CGST payable account head ? 
 Answer: The 
 Basic Amount is appearing in CGST payable because the posting is done 
 correctly. In the Ledger report, when multiple ledgers are debited 
 and multiple ledgers are credited in one voucher, only the top one 
 opposite side ledger is displayed in the report. 
 Q : 
 What could be the reason

 Journal entries ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs because the parent account head is not entered for some 
 of the Sub ledgers selected in the import sheet. Kindly update the 
 parent account head for those entries and then import again. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 is no data appearing in the TDS deduction register for a specific period 
 and company ? 
 Answer: No 
 TDS deduction has been made in the specified period for the selected 
 company. Therefore, no data is appearing in the report. Kindly refer 
 to the Trial Balance to confirm that no postings exist for TDS deductions. 
 Q : 
 Why 
 is there an issue with the loan module ? 
 Answer: Manual 
 entry effects will not be processed in the loan module. An alternate 
 solution is to remove the manual entry and pass the entry directly 
 from the loan module.

 previous year when entering opening unclear cheques? 
 Answer: Opening 
 unclear cheques should be entered on the first day of the financial 
 year. There's no need to input them before the start of the financial 
 year.

 Export to Excel feature becomes active after generating the Receipt 
 Payment. It provides details of the voucher generated against the 
 bill. For Bulk Payment, exporting to Excel is possible only after 
 generating the voucher.
